text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-t-o-p-p-e-d w-a-t-e-r a-n-d a-c-c-e-s-s-t-o t-h-e a-p-p-a-r-t-m-e-n-t-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d d-i-s-c-o-n-n-e-c-t-e-d u-t-i-l-i-t-y m-e-t-e-r-s, a-n-d f-a-i-l-e-d t-o c-o-n-s-u-l-t a-l-e-g-a-l c-o-u-n-s-e-l b-e-f-o-r-e a-c-t-i-o-n.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-t-a-l-l-e-d n-e-w h-a-r-d-w-a-r-e o-n t-h-e e-n-t-r-y d-o-o-r-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a-b-a-n-d-o-n-e-d t-e-n-a-n-t p-r-o-p-e-r-t-y, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d l-e-g-a-l e-v-i-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d b-y l-a-w.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d w-r-i-t-t-e-n n-o-t-i-c-e-s t-h-r-e-a-t-e-n-i-n-g i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e d-e-p-a-r-t-u-r-e, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-r-y e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e o-f i-n-t-i-m-i-d-a-t-i-o-n, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-e-d h-o-u-s-i-n-g c-o-d-e c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r b-l-o-c-k-e-d h-e-a-t i-n-p-u-t-s a-n-d a-i-r c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-i-n-g, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d u-n-s-a-f-e l-i-v-i-n-g c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n-s r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d i-n p-h-o-t-o-s, a-n-d d-e-c-l-i-n-e-d h-o-u-s-i-n-g i-n-s-p-e-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-s-s r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-g-n-o-r-e-d o-f-f-i-c-i-a-l c-o-m-p-l-a-i-n-t-s f-r-o-m o-c-c-u-p-a-n-t-s, l-e-f-t b-e-h-i-n-d a n-e-g-l-e-c-t-e-d m-a-i-n-t-e-n-a-n-c-e t-r-a-i-l, a-n-d f-a-i-l-e-d t-o r-u-n a r-i-s-k a-s-s-e-s-s-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d b-y p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
